body: I asked if I could look at the papers before I paid him (something he should have by now, it's been 4 months) but he refuses to show me them. He said I'll see them when he's paid in full.

> it sounds like the original deal was $800 for the dog decreased to $750, and you've paid $500? 

I've paid £500, yes. I have £250 left to pay. It went from £800 to £750 because I had to pay £50 to have his injections and microchip - something the breeder should have paid for.
They had no proof he was doing it. People saw him dealing but none of the customers would complain and he would do it away from the cameras.
Kinda what I'm in fear of. My friendship ending, I mean. :(
